newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk pipeline restart Thursday on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk pipeline restart Thursday on schedule.

text.p: The main crude pipeline feeding the Russian Black sea oil port of Novorossiisk was set to reopen on Thursday having been closed for maintenance since Monday, a shipping source said.
"(The pipeline) is due to start receiving oil at 12 midday local time," the source said.
The pipeline, with a capacity of about 660,000 barrels per day (bpd) was closed for around 74 hours.
Novorossiisk was open on Thursday after berthings were suspended for around six hours on Wednesday afternoon due to a heavy swell.

Berthings also resumed at the smaller Black Sea port of Tuapse after a closure on Wednesday due to heavy rain and high seas. But the pipeline feeding the port was closed because storage tanks were full.
Odessa and Ventspils on the Baltic were operating normally, the shipping source said.
